rooms.name: Main Corridor
rooms.notes: Corridor that appears to run the length of the ship

rooms.name: Forest
rooms.notes:
Massive forest area. Contains many strange plants and animals, some of which may be edible. There is also a small river that is a source of drinkable water.

An artificial tree projects an illusory dryad that seems to have information about the ship.

rooms.name: The Memory Theater
rooms.notes: Theater that reads the audience's memories and displays them on a screen.

rooms.name: Orrery
rooms.notes: An orrery of a strange, alien solar system.

connections.notes: Heavy metal door, barred from the other side
connections.name: Heavy metal door

connections.notes: A spiral staircase down, behind a plexiglass door
connections.name: Plexiglass Door

connections.notes: A circular hallway that seems to travel in an infinite circle. Going backwards leads to a solid wall
connections.name: Spiral hallway
